heading: Today
text: Morning showers southwest of I-89, scattered northeast, diminishing this afternoon.

heading: Monday Night
text: Clouds. Spotty showers, sprinkles, or flurries at higher elevations.

heading: Tuesday
text: Breaks of sun far south. Passing showers midday and afternoon north of Rt. 4.

heading: Wednesday
text: Mostly cloudy. A few stray rain or snow showers.
